groups.format: Format with no words, only placeholders and symbols. Usually safe to lock, but some languages move the currency sign, reorder the parts or use another separator.
groups.unwritten: A real item whose English description is still a placeholder. Write the English in Unreal instead of locking it.
groups.placeholder: Design-time placeholder or template default; the game replaces it or it is never shown.
groups.plugin: Internal value of the CMG mission plugin (enum display name), not player-facing.
groups.legacy: Legacy, demo or blockout content. Lock it if it no longer ships; keep translating if players still see it.
groups.literal: Address, URL, file path or terminal command; stays as written in every language.
